top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §747.801(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant in care that is not on table food did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four children's files evaluated lacked an address for the emergency contact.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1007(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A current CPR and First Aid needed for primary caregiver.  the cerificates on file expired.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.
